pages.text: The workshop where drones are built. Put in a frame, modules and addons, press $(l)Assemble$(), and take out a finished $(l:drone_systems/drones)Drone$(/l). It also takes drones apart, so you can change them.
The assembler needs power and accepts FE from any side. Place it next to a $(l:generators/combustion_generator)Combustion Generator$(/l) or connect it with cables.
pages.title: Placing and powering

pages.text: $(li)Put a $(l:drone_systems/drone_frames)drone frame$(/l) in the $(l)frame$() slot (on the left). Insert it first: the other slots stay greyed out until there is a frame.$(br)$(li)Put $(l:drone_systems/modules)function modules$(/l) in the $(l)module$() column. The frame tier decides how many module slots are unlocked.
pages.title: How to build a drone

pages.text: $(li)Optionally put $(l:drone_systems/addons)addons$(/l) in the $(l)2x2 addon grid$(). Each slot holds a stack of the same addon. The counter above the grid shows how many you used out of the frame's limit.$(br)$(li)Press $(l)Assemble$().

$(li)The drone takes shape as a $(l)hologram$() on the build plate, under the print head, unfolding as it is made. When the welding head reaches the end of its rail, the drone flashes into the output slot. Take it from there.$(br)Hover an empty slot to see what goes there.

$(li)A drone needs $(l)at least one module$().$(br)$(li)The same module cannot be installed twice.$(br)$(li)The Builder and Bomb Modules fit only a $(l:drone_systems/drone_frames)Mini Drone Frame$(/l), and that frame takes no other module.$(br)$(li)Fortune and Silk Touch Addons cannot go together.
pages.title: What fits together

pages.text: $(li)Put the finished drone in the $(l)output slot$(), with the other slots empty.$(br)$(li)Press $(l)Disassemble$(): its parts return to their slots.$(br)$(li)Change what you want and press $(l)Assemble$() again.
pages.title: Changing a drone

pages.text: Disassembling is free; assembling again costs the usual energy. The drone's charge goes into the assembler's buffer. What does not fit is kept and goes back into the next drone built there. So does its $(l)name$(), as long as you build it from the same frame.
$(li)$(l)Energy per assembly$(): 4,000 FE$(br)$(li)$(l)Time per assembly$(): 5 seconds$(br)$(li)$(l)Energy buffer$(): 20,000 FE$(br)$(li)$(l)Disassembly$(): free
pages.title: Numbers

pages.text: The assembler itself takes $(l)Speed$(), $(l)Efficiency$() and $(l)Battery$() $(l:drone_systems/addons)addons$(/l) on the tab beside its GUI. They change its speed, its energy per assembly and its buffer. See the $(l:drone_systems/addons)Addons$(/l) page for the numbers.
pages.title: Machine addons
